assets.prompt: Create ONE cinematic 16:9 establishing shot showing the PREVIOUS moment of the LAST attached reference. Preserve the exact same dark wooden open barge with lantern at left stern and right-facing bow, the same misty river village and light direction, and same three named characters. In this earlier moment, the same elephant is on the wide RIGHT-HAND PIER, standing safely and calmly NEXT TO the same cream-robed caretaker, NOT aboard. The same teal long-robed child with brown sash and small black topknot stands near caretaker looking at elephant. Boatman in same dark slate robe is aboard the EMPTY boat, at the left stern with oar, same as reference. Camera moved slightly back to reveal enough solid dry pier for the whole elephant. Left half is quieter river and empty barge, right half elephant and child for cover composition. Eye level of child, gentle film realism. No extra people, no text numbers UI logos or modern objects. Critically keep caretaker cream, child teal, boatman dark slate. Correct grounded feet and plausible boat partially submerged in water. Single shot, no montage.

initialPrompts.split: Generate ONE cinematic 16:9 full-frame shot. The FIRST attached image is a contact sheet: the SECOND ROW RIGHT PANEL is the EXACT identity reference for the grey-haired elderly craftsman with a long white-grey beard, brown robe and cream cuffs on LEFT and Cao Chong child in teal robe with cream cuffs on RIGHT. Use this identity, NOT the younger man in left panel. At the same wooden dock model desk, these two people weigh three small wooden blocks using a small wooden balance and bronze weights. Boy right, elderly craftsman left, same faces and clothing and topknots as second-row-right panel. Three distinct wooden blocks on desk. Calm focused expressions. Same misty river and warm morning light in background, film-grade gentle realism. Last image provides river atmosphere only. Output one scene, NOT a contact sheet or collage. No text numbers letters watermarks, modern items, or additional characters.
initialPrompts.pond: Use the LAST attached image as exact identity, lighting, costume and camera-axis reference. Create ONE new full-frame 16:9 film still at the same wooden riverside model desk. SAME grey-haired long-bearded elderly craftsman in brown on LEFT, SAME young Cao Chong in teal robe/cream cuffs on RIGHT, same faces, hairstyles and attentive expressions. REPLACE the balance and blocks scene with a shallow wooden WATER TROUGH on the desk. A tiny empty wooden model boat floats inside it, naturally partly submerged; fine ochre waterline mark on its hull. ONE large wooden reference block rests on the desk left of the trough. FOUR small identical wooden weights rest on the desk right of the trough, NONE aboard the tiny boat yet. Old craftsman has just moved the large block off the boat; child watches the boat intently. Preserve the gentle morning light and misty river background, table texture and warm realistic cinematic finish. No modern objects, text, numbers, UI, miniature people or watermark. The boat is a small tabletop model, not a full-size boat. ONE coherent scene, not a collage.
